summary: Comprehensive testing of Zektrix UK platform bug fixes: Google Auth flow, Chat message duplicates, Push notifications. All 15 backend tests passed. Frontend verified login page with Google login button, admin panel access, chat widget, and push notification subscription UI.

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 during initial render - non-blocking cosmetic issue from recharts library

login_page.description: Login page loads correctly with 'Continuă cu Google' button visible and functional, email/password form present

auth_callback_page.description: AuthCallback.js correctly handles session_id from URL hash fragment via location.hash or window.location.hash fallback

admin_login.description: Admin login works with admin@zektrix.uk / admin123 - redirects to /dashboard

admin_page_access.description: Admin can access /admin page after login - data-testid='admin-page' present, dashboard shows stats

admin_chat_tab.description: Admin chat tab shows messages without duplicates - tested with 1 message, no duplicate message_id found

admin_push_notification_ui.description: Push notification subscription UI visible in Settings tab - 'Notificări Push pe Telefon' with 'Activează Notificări Push' button (data-testid='enable-push-btn')

chat_escalate_endpoint.description: POST /api/chat/escalate works - creates message_id and notifies admins

chat_ai_endpoint.description: POST /api/chat/ai works - returns AI response with session_id

livechat_widget.description: LiveChat widget opens correctly with data-testid='chat-window', shows 4 quick questions, input disabled when not logged in

chat_history_dedup.description: Chat history loads without duplicates - loadHistory in LiveChat.js replaces messages instead of appending, historyLoadedRef prevents multiple loads

BUG_1_GOOGLE_AUTH.description: Google Auth login button visible on login page, AuthCallback.js handles session_id from hash fragment, /api/auth/session endpoint exchanges session_id with Emergent auth
BUG_1_GOOGLE_AUTH.note: Cannot test full Google OAuth flow in automation, but code path is verified

BUG_2_DUPLICATE_CHAT_MESSAGES.description: Fixed in LiveChat.js lines 89-109 and 262-271 in AdminPage.js. loadHistory now uses setMessages(historyMsgs) to REPLACE instead of append. Added historyLoadedRef to prevent double-loading. WebSocket dedup checks for existing message_id before adding.
BUG_2_DUPLICATE_CHAT_MESSAGES.backend_test: Chat history API returns unique message_ids

BUG_3_PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS.description: Push notification infrastructure working: VAPID key endpoint returns valid key, push/subscribe endpoint stores subscription, Settings tab shows 'Activează Notificări Push' button
BUG_3_PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS.note: Full push notification delivery requires browser permission and service worker - infrastructure verified

seed_data_creation: Used existing admin account and escalated test chat messages
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three bug fixes verified: 1) Google Auth - login button visible, AuthCallback handles session_id from hash. 2) Chat duplicates - loadHistory replaces messages, historyLoadedRef prevents multi-load, WebSocket dedup by message_id. 3) Push notifications - VAPID key works, subscribe endpoint stores data, admin Settings tab has enable button.
